item.title: Reports: Burglars steal at least $150,000 from Steelers rookie Max Iheanachor
item.description: Pittsburgh Steelers rookie offensive tackle Max Iheanachor had his home recently burglarized, according to multiple reports

item.title: It's 'Pitt' vs 'Pluribus' in drama and 'Hacks' vs 'Widow's Bay' in comedy at the upcoming Emmys
item.description: The 78th Emmy Awards are set for Monday night, with “The Pitt,” “Pluribus,” “Hacks,” and “Widow's Bay” leading the charge

item.title: US military says it destroyed 5 more Iranian oil tankers after missile attacks on Navy warship
item.description: The U.S. military says it has destroyed five Iranian oil tankers in response to the latest attacks on its warships

item.title: Nepal's flood disaster and the impact of climate change loom large in the icy shadow of Mont Blanc
item.description: Mont Blanc, western Europe's highest peak, is experiencing dramatic changes due to climate warming

item.title: Russia detains a Moldovan citizen suspected of shooting a military officer on orders from Ukraine
item.description: Russian authorities say they have detained a suspect in last week’s shooting that wounded a senior military officer, the latest in a series of attacks on personnel and figures linked to the war in Ukraine

item.title: Trump's map-making on social media stirs controversy in North Atlantic
item.description: President Donald Trump's recent social media map-making posts have stirred tension in the North Atlantic

item.title: Hungry black bears are running into trouble in the Rocky Mountains
item.description: Wildlife officials in the Rocky Mountain region are reporting far more trouble than usual between black bears and people this summer

item.title: Former Colorado crime analyst gets 10-year prison sentence for manipulating DNA data
item.description: A judge has sentenced a former forensic analyst for the Colorado Bureau of Investigation to 10 years in prison after prosecutors said she manipulated and omitted data to speed up her work

item.title: Federal judge temporarily blocks Missouri from using old House map after Supreme Court declined case
item.description: A federal judge in Missouri has temporarily blocked the state from using its old congressional districts in the November election, after the U.S. Supreme Court declined to get involved in the twisting and confusing legal battle

item.title: Airlines scramble to dig out from tech problems that canceled 1,750 flights in the UK
item.description: The head of Britain’s air traffic control system has been summoned to a meeting with the country’s transport minister as airlines scramble to dig out from the backlog triggered by technical problems that have forced the cancellation of more than 1,750 flights

item.title: Meta launches personal AI agent, Muse, emphasizes safety and privacy
item.description: Meta is launching a personal artificial intelligence agent, Muse, for people 18 and over

item.title: Singapore man pleads guilty to orchestrating $240 million bitcoin theft from DC resident
item.description: A 22-year-old man from Singapore has pleaded guilty to teaming up with friends to steal nearly a quarter-billion dollars in bitcoin from a Washington, D.C., resident and then embarking on a wild spending spree with the laundered proceeds

item.title: Renoir paintings are worth a fortune, but not when they're stolen
item.description: Two Renoir paintings stolen from a small French museum have yet to be recovered but if the thieves are hoping to cash in on the artwork, they would be hard-pressed to find a buyer

item.title: Oil rises past $100 a barrel after the latest wave of Middle East attacks
item.description: The price of oil has surpassed $100 a barrel for the first time in almost six weeks after attacks on oil facilities and ships in the Middle East threatened to debilitate an already weakened supply chain

item.title: China hits back at US claims of 'malicious' AI distillation ahead of planned Trump-Xi talks
item.description: China has dismissed U.S. claims that Chinese artificial intelligence developers extract capabilities from frontier American AI systems
